title.narrative: Central America Ethical and HR-based S&T frameworks

description.narrative: The UNESCO Regional Office for Central America and Colombia will support its Member States to begin integrating ethical frameworks for frontier and digital technologies into national governance, taking a realistic and focused approach given resource constraints. The office will lead regional awareness-raising around the Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology, through briefings, national engagement with bioethics committees and Ministries of Health and Science, and connections to UNESCO HQ implementation tools. It will also promote awareness of UNESCO's Declaration of Ethical Principles in Relation to Climate Change among regional climate practitioners and policymakers. Both lines of action will be anchored in the CILAC platform through a frontier technology ethics session at CILAC 2026 (Brasilia, November 2026) and dedicated episodes in the CILAC "Ciencia en Movimiento" colloquium series.
